system.name: MoDM
system.one_liner: a caching-based serving system for diffusion models that mixes small and large models to balance latency and image quality

components.name: User
components.role: submits a text prompt and receives the generated output image

components.name: Request Scheduler
components.role: manages the flow of incoming requests and routes them based on cache match

components.name: Cache Retrieval
components.role: matches a new prompt's embedding against cached images

components.name: Cache Maintenance
components.role: stores newly generated images and evicts older ones

components.name: Request Router
components.role: directs each request to the cache hit or cache miss queue

components.name: Image Cache
components.role: stores final generated images retrievable across model families

components.name: Cache Miss Queue
components.role: holds requests with no sufficiently close cached image

components.name: Cache Hit Queue
components.role: holds requests with a matching cached image

components.name: Mixture of Diffusion Models (GPU Workers)
components.role: pool of diffusion models (e.g. Stable Diffusion, SANA) that serve cache-hit/cache-miss requests

components.name: Global Monitor
components.role: tracks request patterns and system load to optimize model allocation

components.name: PID Controller
components.role: uses collected stats to control model/resource allocation to meet SLOs

flows.what: requests needing refinement from cached image

content.key_idea: A Request Scheduler routes prompts to a cache-hit or cache-miss queue based on similarity to cached final images, feeding a shared pool of diffusion-model GPU workers whose allocation a Global Monitor continuously tunes to meet SLOs.
content.reading_order: User prompt enters the Request Scheduler at top, splits into cache-hit/cache-miss queues, flows down into the GPU worker pool, loops back to update the Image Cache, and exits as the output image, with the Global Monitor observing and steering allocation from the side.

summary: This figure is the full system architecture of MoDM. A user's text prompt enters a Request Scheduler, which computes a text embedding, checks it against the Image Cache for a close match, and routes the request to either a cache-hit or cache-miss queue. Both queues feed a shared pool of GPU workers running a mixture of diffusion models (e.g. Stable Diffusion, SANA); cache-miss requests get full inference from a large model while cache-hit requests get a shorter refinement. Newly generated images are written back to the Image Cache, and the final image is returned to the user. A separate Global Monitor, with a stats collector and PID controller, watches request and cache-hit rates from the scheduler and adjusts model allocation across GPU workers to meet SLOs. The diagram is a flat, icon-annotated architecture diagram with teal, purple and gray color-coded component groups.
summary_zh: 该图展示MoDM系统架构：请求调度器接收用户提示，检索图像缓存并将请求路由至缓存命中/未命中队列，二者共用GPU工作节点上的混合扩散模型池生成图像并回写缓存；全局监控器（统计收集器+PID控制器）根据请求与命中率动态调整模型分配。
